notes: Two isnads (the «ح» branch and «وحدثنا ابن أبي عمر») carry the same saying: two routes; each writes منصور in its own place, so the tail is null
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor gloss and is left out
The last link is عبد الله (Ibn Mas'ud), whose words («ما يمنعني أن أحدثكم») the report relays; «قال كان عبد الله يذكرنا» is the Shaqiq narration that introduces him
